comment: Independent restore.c relink of the polymorphed hero's light source. A debug-mode Healer uses #polyself to become a fire vortex, which emits light, and saves. The second segment restores the game and becomes a newt with #polyself; polyself.c polyself() deletes the vortex's light source with del_light_source(LS_MONSTER, &youmonst), which finds it only if restoring relinked it to the hero as light.c relink_light_sources() does through find_mid(1, FM_YOU).
